primary_champion_selector.definition: MSE over every valid element of the complete seven-variable, complete-L output in paper-aligned StandardScaler space
primary_champion_selector.per_L: mean across the frozen 10 repetitions for each L in {24,36,48,60}
primary_champion_selector.aggregate: average_MSE_4L = arithmetic mean of the four per-L means
primary_champion_selector.normalisation: NONE — do not divide by gpt2_miflu, last_value_naive, seasonal_naive or any other model

key_secondary.rule: reported as a key secondary; MUST NOT be combined with MSE into an invented weighted score

spaces: physical-space where the v2 pipeline supports it
rules: never average predictions across lead times
never pool steps 0-3 into a champion score
fixed step 0 never replaces the paper-aligned selector

literature_peak.PTE: abs(predicted peak week - observed peak week)
literature_peak.PIE: abs(predicted peak intensity - observed peak intensity) / observed peak intensity
literature_peak.report: PTE and PIE separately, plus the joint outcome
